scientific_integrity: Self-contained symbolic elementary-collapse proof; exhaustive finite face-poset checks on ten products. Exact integral homotopy conclusion does not follow merely from numerical checks.
scientific_limitations: Factors must be connected nonempty-edge finite graphs with no 3- or 4-cycles. The decomposition is nonequivariant and concerns only the radius-one closed-neighborhood nerve. Unindexed broader square-completion results remain a novelty risk.
title: Square-double splitting of closed-neighborhood complexes of Cartesian graph products
